## 2026-08-13 · a card about naming, that named a sample

I wrote it myself: two of three shortfalls name what is missing. It was four of six. I sampled my own subject inside a card about refusing to sample, and then found three defects in the detector I built to catch it. The one that stings is quieter: this defect never moves the verdict, so nothing that compares verdicts could ever have reached it. Tomorrow's me — when a break leaves the answer unchanged, only reading the whole returned object finds it.
